description: This Java class 'PolicyIdCreatedStrategy' is an implementation of an event handling strategy for the 'PolicyIdCreated' event within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides a method to set the policy ID in a 'ThingBuilder' object based on the event data.

classes.name: PolicyIdCreatedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a specific event handling strategy for 'PolicyIdCreated' events, extending 'AbstractThingEventStrategy'. It is immutable and overrides a method to modify a 'ThingBuilder' with data from the event.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply the 'PolicyIdCreated' event to a 'ThingBuilder' by setting the policy ID from the event's data.
